reviews.title: Good price-performance ratio
reviews.text: I traveled with this travel agency for the first time. Everything went smoothly. I have nothing to complain about. I'm tall and had plenty of legroom on the plane, which I appreciate. Otherwise, I'm an undemanding traveler, so I can't judge more.
reviews.author: Petr33M
reviews.route: Dresden - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: Canceling flight without any reason
reviews.text: The flight was cancelled without any explanation being provided, resulting in financial loss due to the need to cancel associated bookings such as a rental car and hotel.
reviews.author: Hussein Banjak

reviews.title: Best charter Airline for the price!
reviews.text: Sundair is probably the best Charter airline I have flown with. The planes are modern and comfortable and the legroom was quite good for a holiday airline, there are far worse! What should not be forgotten is the friendly cabin crew, they are doing a great job and the pilots perform good landings! Moreover, the flight was on time and there was no problem with lost baggage or similar, everything went quick and professional as it should be. Of course it's not a service airline like Lufthansa (no food etc) but that doesn't really matter because Sundair is a charter airline which flies you from A to B. If you want service then pay a bit more for Condor but I would say better stay with Sundair, the flights are quite cheap compared to other airlines of the charter class. What I recommend to make the airline even better: - Free bottle of water and eventually a little snack (e.g. chocolate), that would be really appreciated. Also, maybe increase the variety of inflight purchases. - Online Check-In. Seems like many passengers are missing this feature so it might be useful since other airlines offer this already. Other than that, Sundair is a great airline and I will definitely choose you again. Hopefully there will also be some more routes out of Kassel as well as more flights on existing routes, e.g. The Kassel-Hurghada route was booked out in summer so there might be some space for 1-2 additional flights per week next year.
reviews.author: Shayan K

reviews.title: Many thanks to the airport staff
reviews.text: I want to express my admiration for the employee of the airport in Hurghada, Bassem Samir whos working at iab company for having solved all my questions urgently. Perseverance, decency and honesty are about you.
reviews.author: Anhelina Brutska

reviews.title: Schlechter geht es nicht
reviews.text: There is nothing worst than this airline. Starting with their customer Service, and their very rude employees. They do not wanna do anything, very unhelpful! Even then online website is the worst ever! - You cannot really log in and change your booking. They make plenty of mistakes, but you never can hear them apologizing. Each time I fly with them I have the impression that it cannot get worst, but magically it always gets worst!
reviews.author: M S

reviews.title: Check in disaster
reviews.text: Checkin in Dresden fast eine Stunde, Rhodos noch Schlimmer. Ryanair viel billiger und schneller, only two desks open in both airports € 500 for the flights. never again will I fly with this company.
reviews.author: Paul O

reviews.title: Disaster airline
reviews.text: This airline is a catastrophe, my review of it is ACTUALLY 0. The planes are old, seats are clunky, the food tray in front of the seat is very loose and falls out by itself. Due to COVID-19 the smart airline decided to dedicate one of the two toilets only to the crew, and have a SINGLE toilet for 300 passengers for a 4-hour flight. So that the misery does not end here, the only reason I booked this airline was because of the direct flight from Kos to Berlin. But no! The airline decided to have a detour and fly from Kos to Dresden and then from Dresden to Berlin, without informing anyone of this. If I wanted to take a flying "bus" that stops on its way to the final destination I would have looked for something lie that that should be much cheaper. In PANDEMIC time, I booked direct flight because I wanted to absolutely minimize the time inside the plane which I share with 300 other people. But no! Sundair decided to keep us 4 hours in a plane for a trip that should be 3 hours. AVOID IT BY ALL COSTS. Not even water is provided in the plane or basic snack, you must pay for everything. Although the crew seems friendly, one cabin crew move through the cabin like bulldozers and hitting passengers in the aisle seats, all the time. One cabin crew member even did not want to speak to a passenger if it is not in German language, because her English was bad. Hellloooo 21st century and international passengers..... The passenger afterwards spoke German, but this is not acceptable. No in-flight entertainment whatsoever. Customer service via email 0. Speedy reply of emails in generic format actually 10/10 (no value in the email context at all). Dirty plane, dirty compartments, dirt under the seats and around from the previous passengers. No value for money. If something is cheaper does not mean that you should be treated in a lesser way, this is based on business model not on other normal "civilized" factors for flying. Check-in was just ok, nothing spectacular, nothing friendly, just grumpy employees that could be annoyed of many things working the whole day at the airport. As I used 2 flights, Berlin to Kos, and Kos-Dresden-Berlin, the first plane was antique from airberlin with horrible leg space and everything else pretty much horrible, the second plane was refurbed plane on the outside only from Germania. Also old and in bad condition. AVOID AVOID AVOID
reviews.author: ttomovski

reviews.title: Never again!
reviews.text: Worst customer service ever! I paid 50€ for a Covid19 test, which was not necessary because I was vaccinated. After tons of calls and emails Sundair refused to pay me back! Never again!
reviews.author: Abdul Hadi A

reviews.title: The worst flight I’ve ever been on.
reviews.text: This airline is an absolute disaster. 2 hours of delay, no one was wearing their masks during covid-19 even though I kindly asked the flight attendant to speak up. The bad hygiene of everyone on board was disgusting not to mention their service. I recommend not to use this airline.
reviews.author: Georgio Tabet

reviews.title: The worst airline, not even 1/10
reviews.text: 2 hours of delay. A broken chair. The big majority weren’t wearing masks. There was like a party in the back of the plane, people eating and talking all the time without masks, and not even one person of the staff asked them to wear one. No social distancing, my friends and I were lucky not to be infected with COVID-19. I cancelled my return ticket for my own safety, and I only have got back 10,38€ from 110€. What a disrespectful airline that didn’t take any remark into consideration and give me a full refund, they didn’t even apologize! The only good thing is that it was a direct flight from Düsseldorf to Beirut. Next time I prefere to book a transit flight instead of traveling with „Sundair“.
reviews.author: Edmond El Akl

reviews.title: Direct flight with a 'detour'
reviews.text: The only reason I chose this flight is that it offered a direct flight from Heraklion to Bremen (I don't even live in Heraklion but in Chania so I had to travel there) and because I want to avoid unnecessary transitions (at the moment where covid patients are increasing 18.08.2020). So, my only criteria was the duration of the flight and the fact that there is no connection. A couple days before the departure and without being asked, the company decided to first stop in Rhodes which is completely in the wrong direction where we had to leave the aircraft and wait to be cleaned. So, to make it clear, the only reason that I booked this flight is the fact that it was direct since there is a global PANDEMIC. Just to make more money I was exposed in unnecessary risk, while feeling as a hostage in this detour that I never agreed. I expect my full refund and additional compensation for this incredible inconvenience. (The only good thing was the friendly flight attendants)
reviews.author: Thanos

reviews.title: Absolutely terrible customer service
reviews.text: I’ve never experienced such a terrible customer service in my life. Our complaint (broken push chair) was not taken into account as Sundair claimed that we did not raise the complaint within 7 days after the incident: We had the incident logged by the lost/found desk in TXL and called the Sundair customer service on the same day. On that phone call I was told that I would be contacted in a couple of days, but I received no calls/emails at all. I tried to reach them out numerous times in the following days but without any success! Then I decided to contact via email, and guess what happened, they said since i did not raise an official report/complaint within 7 days they can not cover the costs acc. to xyz law. If that’s the law, then the call agent should have guided me through, which was not the case. They just tried to get away with it- Pathetic organization.
reviews.author: Stay692190

reviews.title: Vacation flight to Crete
reviews.text: (+) the flight was in time. Board personal is friendly. Relatively quick checkin at the airport. (-) no e-checkin which is pretty annoying for very early charter flights, particularly if you travel with small kids (departure 5:30). Very old machine although clean, plenty of platic parts are brocken. No entertainment, no board shopping, no food included.
